name: diamond-driller
features: Image loads by choose, drop or paste, with a built in sample scene.
Build pattern turns the image into a numbered square drill pattern using DMC colors with a max colors limit.
Pattern size sets by sheets, total spots, width in spots or cm, spot size and spacing.
View shows color, color plus numbers or print look with zoom.
Color key copies as CSV or downloads as CSV.
Each page downloads as a 300 dpi PNG and the full set downloads as a print PDF.
